architecture: complex H [10,1,C,20,256] -> cat real/imag last dimension -> flatten patch+feature -> Linear(10240,64) -> GELU -> Linear(64,1) -> mean over copies/channels -> one window logit
loss: 0.5 * point-weighted mean softplus(-positive logit) + 0.25 * point-weighted mean softplus(paired-normal logit) + 0.25 * mean softplus(nominal-normal logit)
SELECT: same 0.5/0.25/0.25 coefficients, positives and paired normals equal event/stratum mean; nominal normal uses original fixed panel mean
selection: global minimum SOURCE SELECT across two learning rates and steps 0,40,...2400; tie earlier step then smaller lr; aligned240 restricts to steps<=240
optimizer: fresh AdamW per trajectory, betas 0.9/0.95 eps1e-8 weight decay0.1 with bias exempt;24step warmup
numeric: float32 parameters and source features, complex64 H; no AMP, probability clipping or source-scale correction
extraction: official forward decoder pre-hook stops after encoder; exact representation compared with full native forward
source_feature_cache: SELECT held on GPU;FIT streamed one window at a time and shared between both heads
data_permissions: public SWaT/SMD source roles only; no target read until both trajectories finish and global selection sealed
